text: Entering this space, I sense the crisp cleanliness of modernity: glass, metal, and bright light. Each surface reflects purpose, and the slight tilt of my perspective makes me feel both disoriented and curious. The R+D wall ahead sparks my philosophical muse—the union of research and development, the dance of inquiry and creation. I feel invigorated, but also contemplative about the human quest for knowledge and innovation in environments so meticulously constructed.
